items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: But see I was raising a kid myself, a son.

ctx.x: Speaking of outside, do you think that you stand out from your classical colleagues because you’re also a jazz guy?

Okay I have to tell you the story. But the short answer is yes, is definitely yes. But see I was raising a kid myself, a son. I was in Jacksonville, Florida because I have family support there. And I was always just working at jazz, even though my undergrad stuff was classical too but I studied some at Berklee, but I was just playing jazz and knowing that I could play classical but thinking oh there’s nothing for me to do with that.
